# Mitchel Jonson — Full-Stack Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Mitchel Jonson, a Full-Stack Developer based in Austin, TX, focused on building complete web applications from server-side logic to polished, accessible user interfaces.

## Profile

- [Home](https://example.com/): Full-Stack Developer with +5 years of experience, +12 completed projects, and +20 technologies.
- [About](https://example.com/#about): Computer science background, experience leading teams across government, education, and business sectors.

## Projects

- [Greenline Citizen Portal](https://example.com/projects/greenline-portal/): Citizen portal for transparency and environmental sustainability with interactive maps and open data. Astro, React, Vue.js, TypeScript, Firebase, Node.js.
- [Polux CRM](https://example.com/projects/polux-crm/): CRM system for an insurance company with policy management, customer tracking, and interactive dashboards. Vue.js, Bootstrap, Chart.js, TailwindCSS.
- [Campus FM Radio](https://example.com/projects/campus-fm-radio/): University radio station website with online player, content scheduling, and WordPress administration. PHP, WordPress, MySQL.
- [Nimbus Cloud App](https://example.com/projects/nimbus-cloud-app/): Web dashboard for managing cloud services with usage metrics, billing, and resource administration. React, TypeScript, Node.js, AWS.
- [Brightly Online Store](https://example.com/projects/brightly-ecommerce/): E-commerce for a retail brand with catalog, shopping cart, payment gateway, and admin panel. Vue.js, Nuxt, Stripe, PostgreSQL.
- [Craft Studio Websites](https://example.com/projects/craft-web-projects/): Responsive websites for small and medium businesses with SEO focus. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WordPress.

## Blog

- [React performance: mastering memoization](https://example.com/blog/react-memoization-patterns/): How to use useMemo, useCallback, and React.memo to avoid unnecessary re-renders.
- [Advanced TypeScript types you should know](https://example.com/blog/typescript-advanced-types/): Conditional types, mapped types, and template literals for safer, more expressive code.
- [Frontend architecture that scales without the hype](https://example.com/blog/scalable-frontend-architecture/): Practical approach to maintainable, scalable frontend projects.
- [Astro: faster websites by shipping less JavaScript](https://example.com/blog/astro-zero-js/): How Astro ships static HTML with zero JavaScript by default and hydrates interactive islands.
- [Everyday design patterns in modern JavaScript](https://example.com/blog/modern-js-patterns/): Module, Observer, Singleton, and other design patterns in modern JavaScript.
- [Designing a production-ready REST API with Node.js](https://example.com/blog/nodejs-production-api/): Step-by-step RESTful API guide with Node.js, Express, and best practices.
